prose: What connects Christianity, Tarot, and the stars? In Astrotheology 101, Chance Garton joins Meg Moonbeam to explore the celestial symbolism woven through biblical stories, sacred art, and even familiar nursery rhymes.
Why do a man, an eagle, a bull, and a lion appear around Christ, represent the four evangelists, and occupy the corners of the World and Wheel of Fortune tarot cards?
topics: Mother Goose, “Hey Diddle Diddle,” and the constellations
Cygnus the Swan, sacred geese, and initiation symbolism
The tetramorph: Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John
The four Royal Stars and the seven lamps of Revelation
Why exploring celestial symbolism need not undermine Christian faith
ext: Jesus and solar symbolism, the Sacred Heart and Leo, the Lamb and Aries, Virgo and the virgin birth, Mary as Stella Maris, and further correspondences involving Venus, Moses, and Miriam.
